subject: Two noindex, hardcoded BigOrange custom-home-builder marketing experiences that integrate the full user brief and are ready for review on the existing mapped Netlify site

branches.title: Resolve the two-surface delivery contract
branches.question: Are these review experiences, a production WordPress replacement, or two new public sites?
branches.recommendation: Keep two distinct hardcoded review experiences on the already mapped BigOrange Netlify site, retain noindex, and preserve the canonical production WordPress URL for the later approved migration.
branches.rationale: The project brief authorizes two review iterations and the existing mapped Netlify deployment, while the production WordPress revision still requires a separate final approval.

branches.title: Resolve the visual identity and forbidden motifs
branches.question: Which visual system should govern typography, glass, logo treatment, icons, and decorative restraint?
branches.recommendation: Use the approved Unbounded and Manrope type system, exact BigOrange marks, deep liquid glass, custom SVG icons, orange-white-ink contrast, architectural photography, and no chapter numbers, orbit lines, satellite motifs, or generic icon tiles.
branches.rationale: The user explicitly selected the Primary Portfolio typography and interaction language while rejecting 01/02 labels, blurry particle logos, orbit-like lines, and generic AI design patterns.

branches.title: Resolve keyword, AEO, and GEO intent
branches.question: Which search intents should the copy and page structure protect without turning the page into keyword stuffing?
branches.recommendation: Protect the existing home-builder-agency query cluster, use custom home builder marketing naturally, answer website, SEO, AI visibility, referral, advertising, and measurement questions in static HTML, and keep schema aligned with visible copy.
branches.rationale: Moz and Semrush evidence identify commercial queries to protect and specific informational opportunities; the technical AI-search spec requires direct, visible, self-contained answers without invented authority signals.

branches.title: Resolve voice and proof boundaries
branches.question: How far can the copy go without Janice's interview transcript or new performance validation?
branches.recommendation: Write in BigOrange's sharp, warm, practical Cincinnati voice; use verified public testimonials and case-study links only; avoid invented metrics, Janice quotes, generic AI phrasing, and unverified outcome claims.
branches.rationale: The brand voice guide is authoritative, while PRODUCT.md records the missing Janice interview and factual approval as a hard evidence boundary.

branches.title: Resolve the long-form experience structure
branches.question: How should both URLs remain clearly different while carrying the same complete strategy?
branches.recommendation: Keep Industry Signal as a bright architectural system story and Primary Proof as a dark editorial portfolio story; give each a long, varied sequence with at least six well-spaced images, one purposeful horizontal interaction, strong text stages, direct answers, proof, and a dedicated logo close.
branches.rationale: The user asked for two distinct industry-solutions-style iterations, Primary Portfolio pacing, dispersed imagery, swipe and scroll interaction, stronger text boxes, and a much longer structure.

branches.title: Resolve mobile, motion, and logo quality gates
branches.question: What constitutes acceptable responsive and motion behavior for the two experiences?
branches.recommendation: Require zero document overflow and zero collisions at 390, 768, 1024, and 1440 pixels; usable keyboard controls; reduced-motion support; restrained authored motion; and an exact raster logo handoff after particles resolve in a dedicated final section.
branches.rationale: The supplied phone screenshots show the precise failures to prevent: nav crowding, text collisions, awkward lines, and an unreadable particle logo.

branches.title: Resolve the publication boundary
branches.question: Where may the finished iterations be deployed, and what indexation state must they keep?
branches.recommendation: Deploy only to bigorange-marketing-homepage.netlify.app and its /primary/ route, preserve noindex in both HTML and Netlify headers, and do not mutate the production WordPress page in this pass.
branches.rationale: The existing Netlify site mapping is exact and standing deployment approval applies; production WordPress publication is a separate consequential action that is not approved here.
